title: Day 1: read and choose
question: Compare the two complete versions of each passage, then choose the one you want.

options.label: Greeting and card request
options.note: Combine the guard’s reply and card request. Both greetings still work, with the same bows and pointing.

options.label: A commuter apologises
options.note: Remove the commuter’s extra apology after your card is refused. The guard still beckons you over. This shows his reply if you greeted him.

options.label: The guard points to the bench
options.note: Remove his separate waiting instruction. He still shows nine, points at the bench, and you go over to it.

options.label: The exact time on the bench
options.note: Remove the separate 8:52 text. Your card still becomes valid at nine.

options.label: The gate’s fault announcement
options.note: Remove the machine’s Japanese fault message. The red gate and the explanation of its count remain.

options.label: Explain why he is stuck
options.note: Name the counting error and its result in the same line.

options.label: Hamada repeats “open”
options.note: Keep one slow “open” and the meaning cue. Remove his two further attempts. You still type the word if you help him.

options.label: Hamada’s gesture
options.note: Shorten the description of his attempt to open the gate.

options.label: Mio’s phone messages
options.note: Combine her two messages. Keep her suspicion and point you toward the guard.

options.label: Talk to the stuck man
options.note: Replace his repeated explanation with a prompt on the choice. Helping him and leaving him alone remain available.

options.label: Your word opens the gate
options.note: Add a direct line about the gate opening at your word; remove the guard’s second phone exchange. Eric still connects it to the train.

options.label: Show the guard how to free the man
options.note: Offer the useful mime immediately. Remove the two pointing choices, his explanation of the count, and the repeated description after you choose to lift. The squeeze and cat detours remain.

options.label: Try squeezing through
options.note: Name the briefcase in the optional failed mime.

options.label: The guard laughs
options.note: If you greeted him, remove his separate laugh after he understands your mime. His warmer permission at the end remains.

options.label: Eric thanks the guard
options.note: Remove Eric’s final thanks. Hamada’s thanks, bow and the guard’s permission stay. This shows the warmer permission after greeting him.

options.label: Ask Tama to wait
options.note: Name Tama in the description of her stopping at the bowl.

options.label: The visitor book
options.note: Shorten the line that reveals Tama signed in first.

options.label: Someone pressed five
options.note: Remove the floor-button narration. The lift still stops at five before B2.

options.label: Sales reacts to the newcomer
options.note: Remove the man’s extra question. The meeting gossip and their reaction to your card stay.

options.label: They notice your card
options.note: Shorten the line about why the conversation stops.

options.label: Mori waits for a greeting
options.note: Remove “He waits.” Mori still bows and the greeting control remains.

options.label: Kenji introduces himself
options.note: Merge his introduction and chair apology. Keep the forest-cat detour and Mio’s ban.

options.label: From the cat chair to your first request
options.note: Let Mio give you the request while you are already talking. Remove the invitation and extra Talk action, and bridge into the request. Keep the 1996 card and Eric’s reaction.

options.label: Mori’s copier gesture
options.note: Move the gesture description into the typing prompt. Keep both pronunciations and your submission.

options.label: Tell Mio the copier is fixed
options.note: Merge her reply and move into lunch. Keep her echo of “asked it nicely” and the connection to the train doors.

options.label: Mio’s rack-alarm gesture
options.note: At lunch with Mio, move the flat-palm description into the typing prompt. Both pronunciations and the result remain. Her warmer reply is shown here; her cooler reply also stays.

options.label: Mori’s pouring gesture
options.note: At lunch with Mori, move his pouring mime into the typing prompt. Keep the seven cups and his response to them.

options.label: Mio’s evening opening
options.note: Merge her goodbye and the way she addresses you. She still uses your name if you ate together.

options.label: The sensor excuse, again
options.note: Remove Mio’s repeated instruction after the new request card. Keep the card and both goodbyes.

decision: Jørgen in chat 2026-09-30 agreed to Claude's reading of his train choices. Apply as proposed: g01 g05 g08 g09 g10 g11 g12 g14 g16 g20 g21 l01 l03 o01 o02 o04 o06 o07 o08 o09 o10 o11. Keep original: g04 g06 g07 g18 g19 l02. g13: remove the guard's second phone exchange but do NOT add the new line. Gist: merges fine; keep flavour, context-giving and charming lines and small gestures; keep direct personal phrasing; cut narration of what's visible and extra steps; no more text early.
